job.title: Diesel Mechanic
job.description:
Position Summary

Performs a range of maintenance, repair, and diagnostic tasks on various vehicles and equipment.


Major Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Repairs and maintains systems and parts associated with class 6, 7, and 8 powered tractors.
  • Diagnoses failures and repairs the vehicle's mechanical, electric, and systems.
  • Uses hydraulic jacks to gain access underneath vehicles.
  • Assists in the replacements of engines, transmissions, differentials, and springs.
  • Troubleshoots the repairs of heavy-duty truck engines, braking, electrical, and exhaust systems.
  • Documents and repairs, inspections, and maintenance tasks.
  • Collaborates with business partners for training and assistance on complex repairs and tasks.
  • Tests vehicles after repairs and maintenance to ensure they're functioning properly.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Must provide and maintain personal maintenance tools.
  • Read, write, communicate and comprehend the English language in order to perform the various tasks of the job, including but not limited to: converse with co-workers and members of the general public; understand oral and written instructions as well as governmental regulations; respond to questions and inquiries from management and government representatives; and accurately review and complete various documents, reports and records required of the position.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 2 years of diesel mechanic experience.
  • Proficiency in diagnostic software.


Work Conditions and Physical Demands

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb for extended periods.
  • Frequent lifting, pushing, pulling, or carrying of tools, parts, and equipment up to 100 pounds.
  • Regular use of hands and arms for handling tools, reaching overhead, and working in tight spaces.
  • Ability to climb on, under, and around large trucks and equipment safely.
  • Adequate vision (with or without correction) to read gauges, manuals, and perform detailed inspections.
  • Adequate hearing (with or without aids) to detect equipment sounds, communicate, and follow safety signals.


Pay Rate: 31.55 - 36.30 per hour, based on experience


Benefits

Your success is our success! That’s why we work hard to provide you with what you need to build an awesome career. We are committed to rewarding superior employee performance so that when you work hard, your achievements won’t go unnoticed.


Make Your Move

Our people are the reason we’ve been successful for over a century in the industry. Together, we’ve created a positive culture that’s driven by our core values – like dignity and respect, a customer-first approach, safety and more. With hundreds of terminals across the country and growing, we’re always looking for more collaborative and motivated individuals to join our team. So, if you’re ready to put your career on a solid path, let’s go further.

job.title: Mobile Diesel Mechanic/Truck Technician
job.description:
Overview

Run diagnostic tests, inspect vehicle systems, perform repairs, maintain records, and provide second to none service to customers.



Responsibilities of the Diesel Mechanic / Truck Technician


· Run diagnostic tests on diesel engines


· Inspect vehicle systems, including suspensions, steering, and exhausts


· Test Drive vehicles to gauge performance


· Repairing or replacing vehicle transmissions, brakes, engines, and other parts


· Maintain records of parts inventory and service vehicles


Benefits of the Diesel Mechanic / Truck Technician


· $25 to $50 per hour – Based on experience & availability.


· Commission Available


· Paid Weekly


· Immediate Benefits Package (Health, Dental, and Vision)


· 401K and life insurance


· Start accruing 2 weeks’ vacation time from day 1


· Work from home, take company service truck home


· Never pay for fuel to get to work


Qualifications of the Diesel Mechanic / Truck Technician


· Advanced knowledge of a vehicle, its electrical system, and the mechanisms of a diesel engine


· In-depth knowledge of diesel engine components and operational mechanisms


· Superior knowledge of maintenance tools and repair equipment


· Comfortable using mechanical and electrical power tools


· Must Have Tools


· Valid Drivers License


· Must pass Drug Test, MVR, and DOT Physical


· Availability / Dependability


· 2nd to none service for our customers


· Professional Appearance and workmanship

job.title: Warehouse Lead
job.description:
Description

Job Summary: To assist the Parts Manager in the organization and overall functionality of the warehouse.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate activities of Warehouse staff
  • Create and foster a team environment
  • Prepares orders by processing requests and supply orders; pulling material packing boxes; placing orders in delivery area for shipment
  • Maintain records of all activities and processes pertaining to the warehouse
  • Identify and document damages, lost, or surplus materials stored in the warehouse, file damage or loss claims directly with vendor.
  • Maintains lift truck by completing preventive maintenance inspection sheets
  • Maintains inventory controls by collecting stock location orders and printing receipts
  • Maintain inventory records. Direct and perform monthly cycle counts
  • Match purchase orders to sales orders received and apply to inventory or customer sales order
  • Maintains quality service by following organization standards
  • Maintains safe and clean work environment by keeping shelves, pallet area, and workstations neat, maintaining clean shipping supply area; complying with procedures, rules and regulations
  • Evaluate and recommend cost saving projects to reduce cost without resulting in a reduction of quality.
  • Occasional duties assisting customers on parts counter
  • Answer phones
  • Carry out any additional tasks as assigned by the Parts Manager

Qualifications

  • Job Qualifications:
  • Must have High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Must have a minimum of 5 years’ experience in shipping/receiving, parts or warehouse environment, heavy equipment industry ideal.
  • Supervisory or lead experience in a warehouse environment a plus
  • Must have Three-dimensional vision, ability to judge distances
  • Must have strong planning and organization skills
  • Excellent written and oral communication and basic mathematical skills.
  • Proficient computer skills, including the use of Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to climb heights up to 15 feet, stoop, kneel, push, pull, twist, carry and lift up to 70lbs.
  • Can operate a forklift/lift truck
  • Maintain excellent customer service
  • Ability to work overtime if necessary
  • Must be able to pass a background, physical, and drug screen

job.title: Parts Sales Support Representative (PSSR)
job.description:
Description


PSSR Objective:

The PSSR position is responsible for the coverage, development and retention of a specific group of customers within a specifically assigned sales territory in order to maximize customer satisfaction and product confidence for the manufacturers offered through Power Equipment Co. This will primarily occur as a result of regular customer job site, shop or maintenance facility visits, promoting all applicable product support offerings in an effort to increase parts sales volume and general knowledge of Power Equipment Companies offerings for machine repair solutions.


PSSR Duties & Responsibilities:

  1. Develop & Maintain excellent customer relationships, i.e.: External, Internal.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with the proper Customer personnel.
  • Pass along leads to assigned PECO CSR should the need arise for additional support such as complete machine inspection, Service estimates, machine repair scheduling or PM agreements to ensure total customer satisfaction.
  • Take ownership of customer parts issues and follow-up through closure of issues.
  • Inspect, measure and track undercarriage wear for future planning.
  • Scheduling of preventative maintenance and repairs associated with Company supplied vehicle to ensure safe and proper operation. It is the responsibility of the PSR to maintain the cleanliness of the assigned vehicle.


2. Customer Location Visits.

  • Visit Customer jobsite shop or maintenance facilities to observe and develop an awareness of the potential parts or service needs and record information into computer database (crmSeries)
  • Become familiar with Customer machines & applications.
  • Respond to all Customer request courteously and professionally in a timely and responsive manner.


3. Utilize existing software programs (such as CRM) to create and maintain Customer and machine data.

  • Machine files are to reflect make, model, serial number, smu, etc.
  • Customer files are to reflect address, contact names, phones, etc.
  • Call files are to reflect date, contact name, subject discussed, opportunities, etc.
  • The frequency of Customer visits will be set in crmSeries by the PAR system under Parts Representative C - 4 calls per year or D - 2 calls per year. To be determined by Branch Parts Manager and Product Support Manager.


4. Market PECO Product Support Programs (PSPs), Service & Parts.

  • Present & promote PSPs endorsed by PECO which are conducive to enhancing its core products satisfaction and confidence.
  • Work in conjunction with branch CSRs in promoting PSPs.
  • Insure that all Customers within assigned territory are familiar with available PECO products and services.
  • Develop / Attend / participate in PSP events and promotions.
  • Special projects as assigned


Qualifications

  • Relative 2 yr. College Degree or Technical/Diesel College Graduate or relative Military Training Program minimum.
  • Mid- Level Computer experience (MS Office, CRMseries, DOS, etc.)
  • 2+ Yrs. College or 5+ yrs. utility/construction/mining equipment industry experience.
  • Prior industry repair/maintenance shop management experience preferred.
  • Positive personality, team player, problem solver, self-starter, outstanding integrity, superior communicator.
  • Must have a valid drivers license and able to travel overnight periodically for product training or company related business.
  • Must pass background check, employment physical and drug screen.
